identity.Replaces: 11ea9790 (failed on hardware: Gen I-IV saves could not be opened)

items.name: Save Instances opens your Yellow/Blue save (the Round 15 failure)
items.game: Pokémon Yellow (or Blue) with its RetroArch save in sdmc:/retroarch/cores/savefiles/Gambatte
items.do: Do NOT delete anything in sdmc:/switch/PokeBank-NX first. Press A. In Save Instances pick your Yellow save with A.
items.expect: The game opens (hub / Party / Boxes). Never 'Couldn't remember that exact save choice'. If Home later says 'Save choices are kept until PokeBank NX closes; they could not be stored [...]', the game still opened but the choice was not saved: copy the text in [...] into the comment.

items.name: SD browser opens the same .srm
items.where: Yellow card → + → Source / Game File → − Forget → Y, then A → file browser
items.do: In the browser open Gambatte and pick the Yellow .srm.
items.expect: The game opens. Never 'The save assignment could not be stored safely'. Any failure now shows the reason in [...]: copy it into the comment.

items.name: Assignment survives a restart
items.do: Close PokeBank NX completely from the HOME menu. Start it again. Press A on Yellow, then B, then A on Blue.
items.expect: Both open directly, no chooser. (If Home showed 'Save choices are kept until PokeBank NX closes', the chooser appearing again here is expected: say so.)

items.name: Every route opens the same save
items.do: Press A, then B. Press +, then B. Press Items on the HOME dock, then B. Open Yellow from Quick Games.
items.expect: Every route opens your Yellow save. None shows a chooser or another save.

items.name: Gen II and Gen III open
items.game: Pokémon Crystal (or Gold/Silver) and FireRed (or any Gen III)
items.do: For each card press A; if Save Instances appears, pick your save.
items.expect: Both open. Restart PokeBank: both open directly.

items.name: Gen IV opens
items.game: Pokémon Platinum (or any Gen IV you have)
items.do: Press A. If the chooser appears, pick your save (Save Instances or file browser).
items.expect: The game opens; after a restart it opens directly.

items.name: Gen V assignments kept
items.game: Pokémon Black / White / Black 2 / White 2 you assigned before
items.do: Press A on each Gen V card you used before.
items.expect: Each opens its previously assigned save without asking again (or, if never assigned, assigning works and opens).

items.name: Profile B never opens Profile A's saves
items.where: Tap the profile icon → switch to Profile B
items.do: Press A on Yellow. Then switch back to Profile A and press A on Yellow.
items.expect: Profile B: chooser or 'already linked to another profile', never Profile A's save. Profile A: opens directly.

items.name: Forget then reassign
items.do: Press − (Forget), read the question, press Y. Back Home press A on Blue and pick the save again.
items.expect: Forget removes only the app's link (the .srm keeps its size and date). Picking it again opens Blue.

items.name: Wrong game is refused
items.game: Pokémon White and a White 2 save (or Red with a Crystal save)
items.do: Pick the other game's save file.
items.expect: Refused with a reason; nothing opens; the file is unchanged.

items.name: If anything above failed: diagnostics
items.where: Settings → Enable Debug Logging (ON), then repeat the failing step
items.do: After reproducing, copy sdmc:/switch/PokeBank-NX/logs/debug_*.log and list the files in sdmc:/switch/PokeBank-NX/config (names and sizes, including any legacy_source_bindings.cfg.corrupt-1).
items.expect: The log has a line 'Assignment storage: bindings db=... load=... probe=...' and an 'Assignment (...)' line naming the failing step. Attach both. Never delete the config files.

items.name: Ninjask shows Bug/Flying
items.where: A Ninjask (or Add Pokémon → Ninjask) → Edit
items.do: Look at the type badges under the portrait. Also check Fearow (Normal/Flying), Arbok (Poison), Gengar (Ghost/Poison), Charizard (Fire/Flying).
items.expect: Ninjask Bug/Flying (not Ghost/Flying). Fire, Water and the other types now show their badges too.

items.name: Gender edit keeps shininess
items.where: Edit a SHINY Pokémon with both genders (e.g. Shiny Pikachu) → Gender row
items.do: Press A on Gender. Read the status line. Check the Shiny row and sprite. Press A on Gender again.
items.expect: Gender changes, still Shiny, nature and ability unchanged, and the line says so. If it ever could not keep them, it says 'Gender not changed: it would also change ...' and nothing changes.

items.name: Met Location for species not found in Black
items.where: Add Pokémon → Ninjask (then Fearow, Arbok) Lv 5 → Met Location
items.do: Read the default list, then open 'Unknown location' (the unverified list).
items.expect: Default list: only None / Link Trade / Unknown location (none of these species is caught in the wild in Black). No wild route is presented as verified. Comment if you expected a specific place.

items.name: White 2 / Black 2 Add and Import unchanged
items.game: Pokémon White 2 (after an in-game save) and Black 2
items.do: Press A (Add Pokémon), B, then X (Import from file).
items.expect: Add Pokémon is offered; Import lists only .pk5/.ek5. A first-boot White 2 (no in-game save) offers neither and says why.

items.name: RetroArch quit diagnostic
items.do: Launch Red from PokeBank, then quit RetroArch. Note where you land and any error code. Copy sdmc:/switch/PokeBank-NX/runtime/last-launch.txt and any new file in sdmc:/atmosphere/crash_reports/.
items.expect: Not fixed in this build. This only collects evidence: where you landed, the error code, how you start PokeBank (Homebrew Menu / Album / forwarder), and last-launch.txt.
